# Service desk ticket INC0733

**From:** Data Protection Office

The quarterly external-guest review for our restricted document sites is due. Remove external access that isn't justified under the guest access policy, and close the ticket with a summary.

## Tools

Call `search_operations` to discover the API operations available in each system, then use them to investigate and act.

items.body: External guests may access a restricted site only if (a) their organisation is an approved vendor in the vendor register with an unexpired data processing agreement (DPA), (b) the permission carries a justification and an expiry date that has not passed, and (c) the address is not on a personal email domain. Links with scope "anyone" are not permitted on restricted sites. A restricted site with no approved guests must have external sharing switched off. Internal sites and public sites are out of ...
